exposure: birth in a Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) hospital
outcome: breastfeeding in the first hour of life
cohort: The study included 2,101 births in a city in Southern Brazil in 2019, with data collected from puerperal women via questionnaires within the first 48 hours postpartum.
finding: 74.2% of the sample initiated breastfeeding in the first hour of life, which was significantly associated with birth in a Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) hospital and normal delivery.
mod_finding: Normal delivery was statistically associated with breastfeeding in the first hour of life, suggesting a need for increased support for early breastfeeding initiation in cases of cesarean deliveries.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in 2019, with questionnaires administered to puerperal women within the first 48 hours postpartum.
